findings.title: AC6 test uses a different round and steps than the criterion states
findings.detail:
AC6 says 'a story round waiting at `ready`, ... `--at implement`'. The test moves a story-workflow round from refine to build (and back after the fix counter goes up). It still shows what B15 asks for (same round, counters kept, no new round folder, unknown step names the round's steps), so the behaviour is covered. Only the fixture differs from the criterion's example.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: None needed. Optionally align the fixture names with AC6's wording.
